name: ZCA_FEED_PARAMETERS
description: This table is used to store the parameters for Feed.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAMETER_ID
columns.description: The primary key for the parameter.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAMETER_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the parameter type.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAMETER_DATA_TYPE
columns.description: The data type of the parameter type value.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAMETER_MIN_VALUE
columns.description: The minimum value for the indexing parameter.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAMETER_MAX_VALUE
columns.description: The maximum value for the indexing parameter.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAM_DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: The default value for the indexing parameter.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAMETER_VALUE
columns.description: The value for the indexing parameter.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAM_DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Y if the row was deleted, otherwise N.

columns.name: FEED_INDEX_PARAM_BOUNCE_REQ
columns.description: Parameters which require server(ESS, UI) restart after change in value.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
